cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(gorilla_prometheus_xor VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
option(GORILLA_OPTIMIZED "Build the separately selectable optimized scalar path" ON)
option(GORILLA_SANITIZE "Instrument all core/driver/test translation units with ASan+UBSan" OFF)
option(GORILLA_TSAN "Instrument all translation units with TSan" OFF)
option(GORILLA_FUZZ "Build Clang libFuzzer decoder target" OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Werror -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
if(GORILLA_SANITIZE AND GORILLA_TSAN)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Use separate sanitizer builds")
endif()
if(GORILLA_SANITIZE)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
if(GORILLA_TSAN)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=thread)
endif()
add_library(gorilla STATIC src/canonical/gorilla.cpp)
target_include_directories(gorilla PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
if(GORILLA_OPTIMIZED)
 target_sources(gorilla PRIVATE src/optimized/bitops.cpp)
 target_compile_definitions(gorilla PRIVATE GORILLA_HAS_OPTIMIZED=1)
endif()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(gorilla_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(gorilla_cli PRIVATE gorilla)
add_executable(gorilla_tests tests/test_api.cpp)
target_link_libraries(gorilla_tests PRIVATE gorilla Threads::Threads)
if(GORILLA_OPTIMIZED)
 target_compile_definitions(gorilla_tests PRIVATE GORILLA_TEST_OPTIMIZED=1)
endif()
add_executable(gorilla_bench tests/performance/bench.cpp)
target_link_libraries(gorilla_bench PRIVATE gorilla)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME qualification_preflight COMMAND gorilla_tests)
if(GORILLA_FUZZ)
 target_compile_options(gorilla PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link,address,undefined)
 add_executable(gorilla_fuzz tests/malformed/fuzz.cpp)
 target_compile_options(gorilla_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined)
 target_link_options(gorilla_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined)
 target_link_libraries(gorilla_fuzz PRIVATE gorilla)
endif()
install(TARGETS gorilla ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY LICENSES/ DESTINATION share/gorilla/LICENSES)
